narrative: The small writing-tables open on the knee, two new lines under an older one, the stylus still in the right hand. Candlelight. No face. One surface.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two payments under the old line.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Named on the old line. Not present. Not paid.
